title: OptaMod
description: OptaMod is a lightweight, client-side optimization and utility mod designed to enhance performance and gameplay experience in older versions of Minecraft (1.13.2 & 1.14.4).
body:
# OptaMod

**OptaMod** is a utility and optimization mod designed for Minecraft 1.13.2 & 1.14.4. It provides various tweaks to rendering and game logic to help manage performance and adjust the gameplay experience.

### 🚀 Features

*   **Entity Render Culling:** Stops rendering entities that are outside your specified render distance limit.
*   **Smart Tick Culling (Singleplayer Only):** Halts the ticking and AI of entities that are far away from the player. *(Note: Because this alters server logic, this feature only works in Singleplayer).*
*   **Clutter Reduction (Singleplayer Only):** Limits excessive item drops in a concentrated area and prevents the ambient spawning of Bats and Squids. *(Note: This feature only works in Singleplayer).*
*   **Zoom:** Press and hold `C` to zoom in, which automatically scales down your mouse sensitivity for precise camera movement.
*   **Disable Fog:** Removes the vanilla rendering fog.
*   **FPS Display:** A simple FPS counter in the top-left corner that automatically hides when the F3 debug screen is active.

### ⚙️ Configuration

OptaMod comes with an in-game configuration menu. 
*   **1.13.2:** Access the menu via the "O" button on the Main Menu, or press `O` in-game.
*   **1.14.4:** Access the menu via the "O" button tucked in the top-left corner of the Main Menu, or press `O` in-game.
*   Settings are saved to `config/optamod-settings.properties`.

### 📦 Installation & Multiplayer Note

This mod can be installed on the **Client-Side** for rendering features (Zoom, Fog, Render Culling, FPS). However, please note that **logic-altering features (Tick Culling and Mob Spawning limitations) will ONLY function in Singleplayer worlds**, as those mechanics are controlled by the server in multiplayer environments.

### ⚠️ Important Warnings

**🚫 Speedrunning Restriction:** OptaMod modifies core vanilla mechanics (mob spawning caps and entity ticking). This mod is **strictly prohibited for official Speedrun.com submissions** (e.g., RSG/SSG). 

**⚙️ Gameplay & Automated Farms:** The *Smart Tick Culling* feature may break automated farms that rely on mobs wandering into traps. The *Clutter Reduction* feature prevents Squids and Bats from spawning entirely. If you need these mechanics for your playthrough, you can disable these specific features via the in-game config menu.
